stem.text: Which compound will produce a yellow-orange precipitate when added to 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine?

A.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexene (six-membered carbon ring with one C=C).

B.alt: Skeletal structure: six-membered cyclic ester (lactone) with a C=O group next to the ring oxygen.

C.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexanecarboxylic acid (ring attached to a C(=O)OH group).

D.alt: Skeletal structure of cyclohexanone (six-membered carbon ring with a C=O group).
